[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tfvNzGeZu8s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tfvNzGeZu8s)

_Who are you?_

I'm Fraser, a Melee content creator and editor, and the creator of the popular "Melee Moments" YouTube channel ([Link](https://www.youtube.com/@MeleeMoments/videos)). I've been playing and spectating Melee since 2017!

_What will you make?_

- Daily YouTube shorts covering the full tournament experience featuring informal interviews / friendlies with attending players, allowing viewers to be part of the action in real time.

- 3+ longform videos featuring in-depth, high-production-value interviews with all of Melee's top players, to be conducted at Nounsvitational. Topics may include: analyzing offensive and defensive play, niche Melee tech, practice routines, career highs and lows, and more.

_Why should we pick you?_

If you look at the Melee Moments channel ([Link](https://www.youtube.com/@MeleeMoments/videos)), you'll see that I really care about making high production value content that doesn't waste the viewer's time. I will spend the next few months honing my interview production skills, and travel to Japan in December with the sole intent of making amazing, evergreen videos featuring the wisdom of our current era of top players. 

I've dedicated the last few years of my life to building my channel and pushing Melee content forward, and it would mean so much to me to be able to do that in person with the greatest players in the game right now :)

Thanks for your consideration!

- Fraser

**Who are you?**

My name is Jerami! I’ve been part of the Melee scene since 2014 and began creating Melee content in 2022. Since then, I’ve produced documentaries on top players like Axe and Cody Schwab, and conducted interviews with major figures across the Smash community.

**Why should I care?**

As somebody who has watched every major since 2014, I know the story lines, players, and community and I can bring to life what is happening live at the Nounsvitational. I currently work with professional athletes providing live coverage, and can use those skills for this event like I’ve done at other major smash tournaments. I have the best video and photo quality out of all of the other candidates.

**What content would you bring to the Nounsvitational? **

My content plan for the Nounsvitational will be a mix of interviews, vlogging the event, filming hype moments, and showing what it’s like being at the event. I’ll be uploading daily content in real-time so people can follow along and feel like they're at the event with the players.

**Why are you a great fit for the Nounsvitational 2025 Content Creator spot?**

I think I'd be a great fit, because I’m doing live coverage for pro athletes now and have done it for smash events in the past. I would also bring my full production gear that will blow your SOCKS off with the quality 🤯

This would be an amazing opportunity and I appreciate any and all support given to me. I'll hopefully see y’all in Japan!

- Jerami

proposals.title: KONY 20XX FOR NOUNSVITATIONAL 2025 ❗📹🎮🗾
proposals.tldr: Video Link : Link Hello, Melee community, I’m Kony20XX, a Super Smash Bros. Melee content creator, and I believe I’d be a great fit to cover Nounsvitational 2025 as Lil Nouns’ official correspondent. I consistently post Melee content,…
proposals.content:
**Video Link**: [Link](https://youtu.be/XYlj6xwW2gM)

**Hello, Melee community,**

I’m Kony20XX, a Super Smash Bros. Melee content creator, and I believe I’d be a great fit to cover Nounsvitational 2025 as Lil Nouns’ official correspondent.

I consistently post Melee content, including at least one longform video per week and a short every day. I began doing player interviews in late 2023, and since then, my YouTube has grown to over 5.6K subscribers and my TikTok to more than 2.7K followers.

I’ve edited all 400+ videos on my channel myself, so I'm comfortable with every part of content creation. One of my main goals as a Melee player was to grow the scene, and now as a creator, I try to make fun, welcoming content that brings in new viewers while still entertaining longtime players!

**If selected, here’s what I’ll bring to Tokyo:**

- Player interviews in both my casual “Kony” style and more serious tournament coverage
- A mini-documentary on the tournament
- Daily recap shorts (plus bonus IRL ones)
- IRL content with players and attendees
- A full vlog of the experience
- Daily update posts and photos on X

All of this will be posted on my YouTube, **@Kony20XX**, with shortform versions also on TikTok. These are the deliverables I can confidently promise, though I have many more ideas. I’d love to attend a Tokyo local and interview the Japanese Melee scene, but I’ll stay flexible depending on the itinerary.

I’m already familiar with many of the players attending, and I think the IRL content I could make would fill a unique niche in Melee coverage, highlighting the personalities and dynamics of the players as they explore Tokyo.

I lived in Japan from 2004 to 2007, where I first played Melee and found many passions I still have today. I haven’t been back since, so returning 18 years later to create content in a place I've been eager to return to would mean a lot—and I’d make the most of the opportunity!

If you think I’d be a good fit to represent the scene in Tokyo, I’d be honored to have your vote.
**Thanks for your consideration!** 💫

-Kony

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmXYGHSDWFMtz5EraEy18PRFZA6HGwr9NWEkfo25X5hsYv)

proposals.content:
### VIDEO LINK:  [Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lV8VMSLLa_M&t=1s)

✨ Name / Tag:
n3zmodgod

**🍜 What’s your role in the Melee community?**
I’m a veteran controller modder and long time Melee player who’s been active in the scene for nearly 10 years. I’ve built and modded controllers for most of the top players you know and love, and my work has supported gameplay at the highest level since 2016.

**🍜 Why do you want to attend the Nounsvitational in Japan?**
For me, this is the perfect opportunity to return to the scene in the most meaningful way possible. After YEARS of struggling with my health, I’m ready to give 100% to the Melee Community again. This event is the spark I need to reignite that passion as both a creator and modder. I’ve ALWAYS dreamed of a major in Japan, and now that it’s real, I want to contribute to the story.

**🍜 What value will you bring to the event?**
I’ll be there for the _entire_ community:

- **Free Modding Station:** Full setup with repairs, upgrades, notching, and fixes. 100% free.
- **8 Free Custom Controllers:** Built and given out to players or those in need.
- **Daily Content:** 1 video per day on X (Twitter) capturing all the moments and vibes.
- **Cinematic Recap:** A 10 minute documentary style film to make you feel like you're there with us.

**🍜 What makes you uniquely qualified?**
Few know Melee’s technical side like I do, and even fewer bring the same heart. I’ve worked behind the scenes with pros for years, I’ve traveled everywhere for this game, and I've fallen in love with Japan throughout my life. I’ve also grown as a photographer, and filmmaker in recent years, and JUST upgraded to pro level gear to tell this story right.

**🍜 How will this impact your future in Melee?**
This is the jumpstart I’ve needed for a long time. If I’m voted in, I’m committing to returning to consistent streaming, content creation, and being a fixture in this community again. I want to make people feel proud that they gave me this chance, and show what it means when we all support each other.

**Happy Voting <3**
**– n3z**

proposals.content:
Hi! I'm Sameowtha! I'm a tournament organizer and a photographer for regionals and majors (Photo album -> [Link](https://www.flickr.com/photos/sameowtha/albums/with/72177720326708085)) I can make a video if requested but want to avoid doing so due to gender dysphoria

I specialize in capturing moments at their earnest, even when people are running or tackling each other. I always focus on making sure each player / person looks their best while being as true to themselves as possible, whether they're competing or they're doing outdoor activities. While I haven't been to a Nouns tournament before, I have a pretty good rapport with the players attending through other tournaments, and the ones I host myself; so comfort is not a problem. 

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmaJqHyPRQkJ6maN8Y1okm8wkaQRMozCX5cn5NBn1rKDid)

**What can I offer to the Smash community? **

1. I'll be interviewing the players about their tournament run, how they're enjoying Japan, as well as other topics including how Nouns is directly improving the scene with the funding they're providing.

2. I'll be posting on the daily on my Twitter(X) and Farcaster account about the journey itself and some recaps with pictures taken and clips shot. 

3. I'll prepare some fun questions to ask the players about Smash but also about life in general without devolving too much into their personal life as a form of respect, but to also allow spectators to learn more about them! 

**What about Lil Nouns?**

Lil Nouns is putting a lot of money into this and I believe they also deserve some recognition for the work they do, so I'll be putting effort into: 

1. Making sure to always capture beautiful images of the scenery,  and anything Nounish I can find or re-create with Nouns and Lil Nouns merchandise. 

2. Talking to the players and spectators during off-time or personal time about Lil Nouns and some of the work they funded in 3rd world countries without being too invasive of their personal space. 

While these aren't necessarily objectives that the Smash community will entirely care about, but I'm sure the Lil Nouns communities will enjoy them and some of the funding should go towards it.

proposals.content:
### CREATRESS: Creator for the Nounsvitational! 

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmTLVPZaFhHABqHVzoSwDAiyNPCRjL8i9JZHuM5ypo5p5e)

### WATCH this video intro to Creatress and the Nounsvitational!  >>> [Link](https://youtu.be/SjF-8NiHKXk) <<<<

### 🎤 Lil Nouns Nounsvitational Correspondent 

As the official Lil Nouns correspondent in Tokyo, I will create and distribute on-brand content that brings the tournament to life and amplifies the Lil Nouns voice across platforms, obviously rockin' my noggles! 

#### 📸 Live Event Coverage

- Video recaps from the Nounsvitational tournament floor
- Behind-the-scenes photo stories and candid player moments
- Real-time updates and fan engagement content

#### 🎙️ Player-Focused Content

- One-on-one **player interviews** with exclusive insights and reactions
- Short-form **player profiles** and highlight reels
- In-depth **"Melee Mindset"** clips exploring strategy, psychology, and style

#### 🧠 Educational Segments

- **“Melee for Beginners”**: Accessible content breaking down gameplay, terms, and culture
- Nounified explainers on tournament structure, bracket formats, and major moments
- Intro to Smash and Nouns crossover culture

#### 📡 Content Amplification

- Cross-posting on my **personal X account**
- Custom Nounsvitational Custom Segments on my Youtube channel  [Link](https://www.youtube.com/@creatressart)** specifically on “The Nouns News”** — my new show created for Nounish News storytelling from my perspective, hosted on X, Youtube, Abstract, RAD TV app (available on iOS, Apple Vision Pro, Chromecast)
- All posts will include Lil Nouns tags, mentions, and branded signage for maximum visibility :)

### I'm not as ingrained in the gaming culture, BUT that makes me a perfect person to bring in more new people into the world of gaming and web3, I can relate to the average person who has not been to a high stakes tournament before, and I can explain web3 to anyone, as I've onboarded many people over the years, not to mention bring a little feminine flair to the party. 

### I have also reported live on the ground for many other web2/ web3 crossover events, so why not one that the DAOs I love are hosting and supporting?!

###  Hope to see you in Tokyo!

### -Creatress

proposals.content:
Hello Nouns voters! My name is Maks, but the Melee streets know me as BiGMaks. Joined by my partner in crime, legendary UK youtuber Chaler. In return for your votes, we promise to deliver the ultimate tournament companion experience. Think player interviews, mini-docs, challenges, and fresh content pieces that showcase competitors off-stream like never before. If you want to see the heart of the scene beyond the matches, your vote belongs with us. But who are we?

See our Video for the TLDR [Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1tUdyPdufOA)

As I said I am BiGMaks and I have been commentating EU tournaments for almost a decade and have leant my voice to almost every EU major top8 since 2019. 

Recently, I have thrown my efforts in trying to level up the production value of our streams here in EU and for those who watched UK majors ‘Let’s Start the Fire’ and ‘Lets Drink the Pool’ will have seen my mix of short and long form content showcasing our wonderful community outside the context of just winning and losing a set. Those unfortunate enough not to be familiar with Chalers videos have missed out on his amazing ability to tell some of Melee’s best stories and show the humanity behind the game. Together we will bring you the best content this fair isle can! [Link](https://www.youtube.com/@ChalerYT/videos)

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmVLmCE459cLrwJb26Df745RTzRn8xgTXaTMoUGTVpJqXv)

As mentioned in the beginning our aim if we win would be to provide a tournament companion experience. Those who have seen my content before will know what to expect. Short form gameshow content as well as, longer content pieces that showcase personality rather than skits. [Link](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLvTpAmQKqZYqnthPyxgYCg6OC_tJUy4Ve)

An addition to these kinds of pieces audiences have seen from us in the past, with this tournament we will also film some player mini-docs for the lesser known players to have their stories heard, interviews during the tournament to stay up to date with the competitors and a return of my long defunct series ‘Going 0-2’ where I travel to locals to show how fun the melee scene can be even if you’re not a world traveling top 100 ranked player
